notes.title: Need to Know v1.29.1 Update - Changelog
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for your continued feedback and bug reports! If you have any bug reports or suggestions to make - you can also visit this board to post them.

This update includes a number of fixes and performance improvements, to generally improve the stability of the game. Saving and loading is now faster, as is game startup, the progress of which is now shown by a loading bar on the splash screen. The installed size of the game has also been reduced, without compromising in-game visual and audio quality.

For a list of the changes made in v1.29.1, see below:

 Added loading bar to splash screen, to show loading progress more clearly and prevent game from hanging
 Changed backend of database loading to prevent memory allocation crash which was occurring on game startup for some users
 Changed backend of save game system to reduce loading lag on game startup, and significantly improve performance when logging out of game
 Fixed issue where ‘Skip to First Workday’ option on main menu was not working correctly
 Fixed possible game over loop in Skeleton Key missions directly after Operation SpotlessComb 2
 Fixed incorrect map in Skeleton Key missions directly after Operation SpotlessComb 2
 Fixed unclear rules in Operation SpotlessComb 1
 Reduced installed size of game by optimising internal compression for some assets
 General bug fixes and typo fixes

notes.title: Need to Know Refresh Update (v1.25.0) - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve just released the Refresh Update for Need to Know, featuring a streamlined start to the game, dozens of usability updates, and all of the changes and fixes we’ve made since release. 

For this update, we’ve focused mainly on structural amendments, particularly in Clearance Level 10. Some story elements have been repositioned, including the opening prologue and some early scenes. Our goals are to get you into gameplay quickly, space out the early story development, and allow you to advance to a higher difficulty level earlier. However, no missions have been removed, simply relocated to different points in the story, or made optional.

Home missions now have a lock-out deadline, so you’ll face a (forgiving) time pressure to make the experience a little more intense. We have also made several usability improvements, such as making it easier to skip the PeepR tutorials.

We’ve made an effort to ensure all existing save games will work with these changes, so please let us know if you experience any issues! As always, thanks so much for your continued feedback and bug reports. If you have any bug reports or suggestions to make - you can also visit this board to post them.

For a list of the changes made in the Refresh Update (v1.25.0), see below:

 Added dialogue option to skip to end of Clearance Level 10 without needing to complete all side missions
 Changed Clearance Level 10 structure to get to gameplay quicker, by moving some scenes to later in the Clearance Level
 Removed some redundant dialogue from Clearance Level 10
 Fixed issue with inconsistent positioning of personal stats panel
 Fixed outcome issue in Operation EchoWell
 Fixed evidence issue in FreshScent
 General bug fixes and typo fixes

v1.25.0 includes the following changes from v1.24.0b:

 Added time pressure to home missions, as CodeX system now has intrusion detection
 Changed automatic layout of evidence to place items higher-up by default
 Changed home mission rule panel to allow more information to be displayed at once
 Fixed issue with auto-layout of evidence that occurred when there was hidden evidence
 Fixed issue with Peepr sometimes incorrectly appearing on-screen during home missions

notes.title: Original Soundtrack available now! Plus v1.22.0 changelog

notes.title: Need to Know v1.20.1 Update - Changelog

notes.title: Need to Know v1.20.0 Update - Changelog
notes.notes:
This update includes some bigger changes to Clearance Levels 10 & 9 to add some more complexity to gameplay, by introducing new powers earlier and using a wider variety of tools, along with other changes. This should serve both to increase the enjoyability of these parts of the game and to reduce the learning curve in Clearance Level 8.

Once again, thank you for your bug reports and feedback so far! If you have any bug reports or suggestions to make - you can also visit this board to post them.

For a list of the changes made in v1.20.0, see below:

Added new powers to Clearance Levels 10 & 9, to introduce power unlocking and choice earlier in the game
Added use of Assay tool to reveal hidden profiles in Clearance Level 9, to introduce mechanic earlier and increase complexity of gameplay
Added rule numberings to evidence wave missions, to show more clearly which rule is applicable in each evidence wave
Changed some dialogue in Clearance Levels 10 & 9, to better introduce Grey Day Attack investigation
Fixed issue with DeepLinking between suspects in Operation NewFriends Phase 2
Fixed issue where tutorial on first workday would break if the player logged in too quickly
Fixed display issue with Clearance Level in mission summary
General bugfixes and typo fixes

notes.title: Need to Know v1.19.3 & v1.20.0b Updates - Changelog
notes.notes:
We've just released two different updates to the game - one is a normal update (v1.19.3), and the other is a beta update, which includes some bigger changes to early parts of the game that haven't yet been fully-tested (v1.20.0b). If you'd like to try these beta features out, see below for more information.

As always, thank you for your bug reports and feedback! If you have any bug reports or suggestions to make - you can also visit this board to post them.

v1.19.3
This update is the next in a series of updates to improve clarity and usability of the game, particularly in the early stages, in response to feedback and reports.

For a list of the changes made in v1.19.3, see below:

Added ability to skip to first workday at the Department when starting a new game
Fixed crash which could occur during end credits
Fixed inconsistent description on first Grey Day chart entry
General bugfixes and typo fixes


v1.20.0b
This optional update includes some bigger changes to Clearance Levels 10 & 9 to add some more complexity to gameplay, by introducing new powers earlier and using a wider variety of tools, along with other changes. This should serve both to increase the enjoyability of these parts of the game and to reduce the learning curve in Clearance Level 8.

To access this update, right-click on the game in Steam and select 'Properties', then go to 'Betas', and select the 'beta - Dev testing' option.

For a list of the changes made in v1.20.0b, see below:

Added new powers to Clearance Levels 10 & 9, to introduce power unlocking and choice earlier in the game
Added use of Assay tool to reveal hidden profiles in Clearance Level 9, to introduce mechanic earlier and increase complexity of gameplay
Added rule numberings to evidence wave missions, to show more clearly which rule is applicable in each evidence wave
Changed some dialogue in Clearance Levels 10 & 9, to better introduce Grey Day Attack investigation
Fixed issue with DeepLinking between suspects in Operation NewFriends Phase 2
General bugfixes and typo fixes

Fixed an evidence issue in Operation HealthyGlow where evidence was marked as missed when it was actually not suspicious
Fixed issue where some dates for employment evidence were not displaying correctly
General bugfixes and typo fixes

notes.title: Quick post-release update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, just a quick post because we’re so swamped right now.

Thank you for your feedback on the game so far! We’ve seen that many of you feel that aspects of the game are not clear enough. There have also been issues with bugs.

We’re really sorry for problems we’ve missed that have affected the experience so far. It’s certainly not due to lack of effort, as we’ve all been working extremely hard for some time now.

However, we’re now working on bug fixes and clearer explanations, so that you can enjoy the gameplay and story without interruptions or confusion. We will have improvements and bugfixes for Need to Know online ASAP.

Once again, thanks so much for the feedback - we’ll be in touch again soon!
